turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Hi, how are you holding up?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: I'm baking something for my friend's birthday, and I can't decide what.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Let me finish describing every option before you respond.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: The first idea is a classic chocolate layer cake with fudge frosting, which takes most of a day.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Then there's a lemon drizzle loaf, which is simple and I've made it before.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Option three is a big batch of decorated cupcakes so everyone gets their own.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: And the last one is a fruit tart with a homemade crust, which looks really fancy.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Okay, that's all of them. What do you think?

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: What's your friend's favorite flavor? If they love chocolate, go for the layer cake. If you're short on time, the lemon loaf with a candle on top is still lovely.
